scope: Packaged Windows build language planning and doctor-to-patient playback QA

removed_only_before_planning: vocative ơi after a supported subject
trailing polite markers nha, nhé, nhá, ạ
planner_rules.safety_rule: A sentence with unsupported meaning is blocked from avatar playback and asks the doctor to edit, send text, or ask the patient to repeat.

planner_cases.input: Y tá ơi, đo nhiệt độ nha
Bác sĩ ơi, uống nước nhé
Y tá ơi, không đo nhiệt độ nha
Y tá ơi, đo nhiệt độ và uống nước nha

packaged_runtime_qa.doctor_input: Y tá ơi, đo nhiệt độ nha
packaged_runtime_qa.unknown_warning: Có từ hoặc nội dung chưa hỗ trợ avatar
packaged_runtime_qa.visual_result: Doctor and patient screens rendered in the packaged 16:9 layout; avatar controls showed active playback and completed playback.

realtime_gate_evidence.interpretation: One pause closes one utterance; silence does not create repeated drafts.

limitations: The packaged QA environment had no usable microphone, so a real spoken sentence was not captured in this run.
Camera and human signing quality still require an on-device human trial before clinical use.
